evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Aphoristic maxim crystallizing a technical claim into a matched-opposition clause — domain jargon (rollback, rehearsed) rendered in plain, memorable syntax. This is the document's register signature.
